title: Events per minute by agent type
description: Normalized CIM events (sessions, LLM calls, tool calls) per minute.
viz_content: SELECT window_start AS time, agent_type, count() AS events FROM tumble(table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_event), event_time, 1m) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} GROUP BY window_start, agent_type ORDER BY time

title: Open threats by severity
description: Rows in agentguard_threats not yet acknowledged or cleared.
viz_content: SELECT severity, count() AS threats FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_threats) WHERE status = '' OR status = 'open' GROUP BY severity ORDER BY severity

title: Tokens by model
description: LLM calls and input/output tokens per model in the selected window.
viz_content: SELECT tags['model'] AS model, count_if(metric_name = 'llm.call') AS calls, to_int64(sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.input_tokens')) AS input_tokens, to_int64(sum_if(metric_value, metric_name = 'llm.output_tokens')) AS output_tokens FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_cim_metrics) WHERE event_time > now() - {{filter_time_range}} AND metric_name LIKE 'llm.%' GROUP BY model ORDER BY input_tokens DESC

title: Recent threats
description: Latest security detections across all agents.
viz_content: SELECT last_seen, severity, rule_name, agent_id, session_id, if(status = '', 'open', status) AS status FROM table([[ .DB ]].agentguard_threats) WHERE last_seen > now() - {{filter_time_range}} ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 50
